findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "paid-mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_url · Private data: invoice_preflight_quote, check_url, scan_content, simulate_transaction, check_wallet, estimate_trade_execution, analyze_whale_activity, token_security_audit · Public sink: invoice_preflight_quote, scan_content, simulate_transaction, check_wallet · Destructive: backtest_strategy.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_url · Private data: invoice_preflight_quote, check_url, scan_content, simulate_transaction, check_wallet, estimate_trade_execution, analyze_whale_activity, token_security_audit · Public sink: invoice_preflight_quote, scan_content, simulate_transaction, check_wallet · Destructive: backtest_strategy

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
